title: No News is Good News: A Critique of the One Billion Word Benchmark
reasoning: The paper's primary argument is a critique of the One Billion Word Benchmark on ethical grounds. It extensively discusses harms such as the generation of fake news, the presence of 'decontextualized hate speech' and 'toxic text', and the propagation of media bias. These ethical considerations are central to the paper's thesis and not just a brief mention in a limitations section.
